accepted_limitations: Backend parity covers the CPU-only JAX build and Dask over NumPy; no accelerator device was exercised, consistent with PERF-001.

Config-case, rejection-probe, solver and backend-parity input digests are taken over the canonicalized document with the volatile temporary workspace prefix replaced by the literal <workspace>, so each digest names the scientific input rather than the host path.

Every full-efield load-stage exact_message embeds the resolved transport path of the measurement's own temporary fixture, because the accepted messages are named-fields and render that path; the path is host state and enters no fingerprint, digest or scientific identity.

Every receptor_factorizations row projects two distinct quantities (j_native = C @ E, composed_e = E); the superseded record collided them, the four regenerated rows carry four distinct digest pairs, verified independently by the reviewer through production's own entry points, not merely by the envelope's witness-adequacy guard.

The JAX backend-parity rows declare atol 1e-12, the repository's float64 absolute tolerance, beside the accepted backend rtol 1e-12: the measured JAX-CPU difference on these full-efield workloads is 2.2e-16 (point) and 1.2e-16 (HEALPix) rather than exactly zero; NumPy and Dask remain byte-identical at exactly zero.

The crossed-ideal-dipole oracle cannot carry the conjugation-observability control because it reproduces pyuvdata.analytic_beam.ShortDipoleBeam._efield_eval bit-for-bit and is purely real; the quadrupolar fixture is the carrier that fires all four sign/conjugation checks.

The e_matrix field in receptor_factorizations was, on direct byte-level inspection, unaffected by the composed_e defect in both the superseded and the regenerated artifact and already held the true composed E; the sixth correction's narrative describing e_matrix as also having been byte-identical to j_native is a minor overstatement with no functional consequence, since no schema guard is keyed on e_matrix and its correctness was independently confirmed in both review rounds.

The retained cross-validation comparison against pyuvsim 1.4.0 bounds only the mechanism-free total-intensity (3.325e-4) and Stokes-V (1.925e-10) classes, both well inside the accepted 1.9e-3 SCI-007 frame residual, and records the Q/U-carrying correlations (4.16-10.24 per cent) as a structured, mechanism-explained open disagreement (the pyradiosky local-linear-mirror) under the frozen parameter-free transfer-solve construction local_u_negation_in_reference_coherency_v1 (absolute residual 7.36e-4 <= 1e-3, reassembly_gap 5.03e-14 <= 1e-12), never as an unqualified validation claim.

The witness-adequacy guard (composed_e.c_order_sha256 != j_native.c_order_sha256) is a fixture-adequacy obligation on the evidence author, not a physics theorem: E can legitimately equal J_native when J_native's columns lie in the +1 eigenspace of C^dagger, which occurs at every chi for a linear receptor (a reflection with eigenvalues {+1,-1}) and at the isolated chi=pi/4 for a circular receptor -- independently re-derived and confirmed by the reviewer via closed-form eigenvalue analysis and a 20001-point numerical sweep.

The wrap-continuity witness recorded on every basis_conversions row uses production's own second-difference predicate (seam second difference against eight times the interior maximum plus the converted-matrix bound); the superseded first-difference form is not retained because it produced a sampling-symmetry false positive on the quadrupolar science.
